subject: Re: Kickoff: Lighthouse relighting primitive
body:
Dmitri,

Resourcing:

- Yusuf Keita 50% research lead; Hyun Traore 30% on the volume-rendering integration; Wanjiru Horvat 40% pipeline plumbing; Linnea Yamada 20% eval support.
- Compute: modest. 16 A100s on titan-a100 for the retraining runs in April; inference for the demo is single-GPU.

On data: our own interior-scene stereo captures will eventually live in Corpus so other teams can reuse them. Corpus v2's migration freeze is 2026-07-24, so we have comfortable runway to land our interior-scene captures in Corpus after this window closes — I'm scheduling the ingestion work for the first two weeks of July. Wanjiru will carry that as a tail task.

Risk I'm watching: the license-encumbered pieces Yusuf is scoping (nets.py and geometry/projector.py both reference external code). If we must reimplement, that's ~3 weeks of Hyun's time.

Santiago
